description: This file contains functions for manipulating X509 certificate structures, including setting and getting version, serial number, issuer and subject names, validity periods, public key, extensions, and signature algorithm.

methods.name: X509_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the X509 certificate, defaulting to v1 if not set.

methods.name: X509_set_version
methods.description: Sets the version of the X509 certificate, handling default and boundary conditions.

methods.name: X509_set_serialNumber
methods.description: Sets the serial number of the certificate, ensuring correct ASN.1 type.

methods.name: X509_set_issuer_name
methods.description: Sets the issuer name of the certificate.

methods.name: X509_set_subject_name
methods.description: Sets the subject name of the certificate.

methods.name: X509_set1_notBefore
methods.description: Sets the notBefore validity time.

methods.name: X509_set_notBefore
methods.description: Alias for setting notBefore time.

methods.name: X509_get0_notBefore
methods.description: Gets the notBefore validity time.

methods.name: X509_getm_notBefore
methods.description: Gets a mutable pointer to notBefore time.

methods.name: X509_get_notBefore
methods.description: Macro alias for getting notBefore time.

methods.name: X509_set1_notAfter
methods.description: Sets the notAfter validity time.

methods.name: X509_set_notAfter
methods.description: Alias for setting notAfter time.

methods.name: X509_get0_notAfter
methods.description: Gets the notAfter validity time.

methods.name: X509_getm_notAfter
methods.description: Gets a mutable pointer to notAfter time.

methods.name: X509_get_notAfter
methods.description: Macro alias for getting notAfter time.

methods.name: X509_get0_uids
methods.description: Retrieves issuer and subject UIDs.

methods.name: X509_set_pubkey
methods.description: Sets the public key for the certificate.

methods.name: X509_get0_extensions
methods.description: Retrieves the extensions of the certificate.

methods.name: X509_get0_tbs_sigalg
methods.description: Retrieves the signature algorithm.

methods.name: X509_get_X509_PUBKEY
methods.description: Retrieves the public key structure.
